items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And Georgie Auld, Byas, Don Byas, Roy Eldridge, Kenny Clark, there was just

ctx.x: the time, and she loved the band, and she recorded with our band. The only addition to our band at that time was Herbie Haymer, who was quite a saxophone player. He was working with she and Red Norver.

We did some tunes, 'Are You Looking At Me,' I can't think of all the tunes but they were very good. And when I went to New York I got in touch with her and we started recording together again. And I recorded as you know, I told you I recorded with Lady Day, did quite a few things with her. One record I did with her was done -- was arranged and conducted by Don Redman, an all star band also.
